objective.description: Run to the finish without hitting a trash can.

tutorial.controlsHint: Tap or Space to jump, swipe or arrows to change lane.
tutorial.goalLine: Reach the finish line. Jump, slide and switch lanes.

objective.description: Jump across the platforms to the flag without touching a rock.

tutorial.controlsHint: Arrows or A/D to move, Space or tap to jump.
tutorial.goalLine: Dodge the lava. Reach the flag. Jump over gaps and hazards.

objective.description: Dodge the wind-up, strike back and knock out 5 waves of zombies.

tutorial.controlsHint: Drag or arrows to move, Attack or J to strike. Step aside when it winds up.
tutorial.goalLine: Knock out 5 waves of zombies.

objective.description: Pass every gate, dodge the cannonball and reach the lighthouse.

tutorial.goalLine: Pass every gate and reach the lighthouse.
tutorial.controlsHint: Drag or arrows to steer. Down or a second finger brakes.

objective.description: Cook all 5 pancakes in each of 2 rounds before the cat catch you.

tutorial.controlsHint: Drag or arrows to move, hold Use next to a target.
tutorial.goalLine: Cook all 5 pancakes, 2 rounds.

objective.description: Stop 6 waves of crows before they reach you.

tutorial.controlsHint: Tap where you aim to shoot. Arrows aim, Space fires.
tutorial.goalLine: Stop 6 waves of crows. Each wave is faster.

objective.description: Hit every tower of pumpkin in 87 seconds before you run out of throws.

tutorial.controlsHint: Hold to power up, drag up or down to aim, let go to throw.
tutorial.goalLine: Hit every tower of pumpkin in 87 seconds.

objective.description: Stop the marker in the zone 10 times. It speeds up.

tutorial.controlsHint: Tap or Space to stop the marker.
tutorial.goalLine: Stop the marker in the zone 10 times. It speeds up.

objective.description: Hit each tile in its lane on the beat and play the song to the end.

tutorial.controlsHint: Tap the lane, or D F J K, on the beat. M toggles sound.
tutorial.goalLine: Tap each lane as its note hits the line. The song gets busier.

objective.description: Beat 9 rivals in a row. Each one attacks faster.

tutorial.controlsHint: Tap right or Space to strike, tap left or Down to dodge.
tutorial.goalLine: Dodge the wind-up, strike in the opening. Beat 9 rivals.

objective.description: Flap through the gaps between the pipes to the finish.

tutorial.controlsHint: Tap or Space to flap.
tutorial.goalLine: Fly through the gaps to the finish. They get tighter.

objective.description: Catch 30 falling flies and dodge the bombs.

tutorial.controlsHint: Tap a lane, drag, or use the arrows to move.
tutorial.goalLine: Catch 30 flies. Dodge the bombs!

objective.description: Whack 30 gophers as they pop up, but spare the gophers.

tutorial.controlsHint: Tap a hole to whack. Arrows and Space work too.
tutorial.goalLine: Whack 30 gophers. Spare the gophers!

objective.description: Hold the couch against 30 vacuum robots and their boss.

tutorial.controlsHint: Tap a lane to shoot. Hold a lane to place a guard. Arrows and Space work too.
tutorial.goalLine: Hold the couch! Stop every vacuum robot.

objective.description: Slice 30 flying fishes, but not the bombs.

tutorial.goalLine: Slice 30 fishes. Not the bombs!
tutorial.controlsHint: Tap a lane to slash above the line. Arrows and Space work too.

objective.description: Hop 18 rows across roads, rivers and rails to the meadow. Dodge the ghosts.

tutorial.controlsHint: Tap to hop forward, swipe to hop sideways or back. Arrows work too.
tutorial.goalLine: Cross 18 rows to the meadow!

objective.description: Pick the better gate to grow your crowd, dodge the saws, then beat the ogre.

tutorial.goalLine: Grow your crowd, then beat the ogre!
tutorial.controlsHint: Drag left or right to pick a gate. Arrows work too.

objective.description: Drop ones squish togethers and merge two of a kind into bigger ones. Make 50 merges before time runs out.

tutorial.goalLine: Merge 50 times before time runs out!
tutorial.controlsHint: Drag to move, let go to drop. Arrows and Space work too.

objective.description: Push 7 other bumper bots out of the ring in three rounds. Do not fall off yourself.

tutorial.controlsHint: Drag to move, tap to lunge. Arrows and Space work too.
tutorial.goalLine: Push every other bumper bot out of the ring!

objective.description: Beat the rival vehicles to the finish.

tutorial.controlsHint: Drag/arrows steer. Down or second finger brakes. Avoid barriers.
tutorial.goalLine: Beat the rival vehicles to the finish.

objective.description: Find a path through the maze to the exit.

tutorial.controlsHint: Drag in any direction, or use arrows or WASD to walk.
tutorial.goalLine: Find a path through the maze to the exit.

objective.description: Score in every goal.

tutorial.controlsHint: Drag to aim. Hold and release to shoot; the yellow dial shows when you can fire.
tutorial.goalLine: Score in every goal.

objective.description: Reach the exit doors before the Roomba catches you.

tutorial.goalLine: Escape through the exit doors. The Roomba hunts you.
tutorial.controlsHint: Tap where to run. Use a cart to stun the Roomba.

objective.description: Pass five neon gates in order.

tutorial.goalLine: Pass all 5 gates in order before time runs out.
tutorial.controlsHint: Tap the next gate to race to it.

objective.description: Collect five glowing mushrooms, then step through the portal.

tutorial.goalLine: Collect 5 mushrooms, then reach the portal.
tutorial.controlsHint: Tap a mushroom to walk to it. Tap again to pick it up.

objective.description: Steal the diamond, then slip out through the exit.

tutorial.goalLine: Steal the diamond and get out. Stay off the guards' paths.
tutorial.controlsHint: Tap the diamond to sneak to it. Tap again to take it.

objective.description: Knock out all five slimes.

tutorial.goalLine: Knock out all 5 slimes.
tutorial.controlsHint: Tap a slime to approach, tap again to hit it.

objective.description: Carry the cake to the party table without breaking it.

tutorial.goalLine: Bring the cake to the party table. Avoid the waiter.
tutorial.controlsHint: Tap the cake, pick it up, then tap the table.

objective.description: Serve every customer the dish they ordered before the shift ends.

tutorial.goalLine: Serve each customer the dish they ordered before time runs out.
tutorial.controlsHint: Tap a dish to grab it, then tap the customer who ordered it.

objective.description: Cross the lava field to the far ledge.

tutorial.goalLine: Reach the far ledge. Lava vents pulse.
tutorial.controlsHint: Tap a stepping stone when the lava is calm.

objective.description: Survive 60 seconds while red floor tiles pulse.

tutorial.goalLine: Stay off the red tiles for 60 seconds.
tutorial.controlsHint: Tap a safe spot to move there.

objective.description: Press red and blue, but not green, to open the door.

tutorial.goalLine: Open the vault door with the right buttons.
tutorial.controlsHint: Tap a button to walk there, tap again to press it.

objective.description: Push a crate onto each pressure plate to open the door.

tutorial.goalLine: Push a crate onto every plate to open the door.
tutorial.controlsHint: Tap a crate to push it one step toward its plate.

objective.description: Knock off the red, blue and green vases in that order to reach the fish.

tutorial.goalLine: Knock the vases off in the right order to reach the fish.
tutorial.controlsHint: Tap a vase to walk there, tap again to knock it off.

objective.description: Search the room for three hidden toys, then leave through the door.

tutorial.goalLine: Find 3 hidden toys, then leave through the door.
tutorial.controlsHint: Tap a hiding spot to search it. Tap a toy to pick it up.

objective.description: Collect three keys, then reach the exit. The walls shift back and forth.

tutorial.goalLine: Collect 3 keys, then reach the exit. Walls shift every 2 s.
tutorial.controlsHint: Tap to walk. Never step where a wall stands.

objective.description: Collect three marbles, then reach the finish line. Freeze while the light is red.

tutorial.goalLine: Collect 3 marbles, then cross the finish line. Freeze on red.
tutorial.controlsHint: Tap a marble to walk to it. Stand still while the doll watches.

objective.description: Eat smaller fish to grow, keep away from bigger ones, and outgrow them all within 40 seconds.

tutorial.goalLine: Outgrow every hunter within 40 seconds.
tutorial.controlsHint: Drag or arrows to swim. You are blue: eat yellow and green, flee red.

objective.description: Dodge the swings, strike in the openings and knock your rival out.

tutorial.goalLine: Dodge the wind-up, strike in the opening. Knock out the rival.
tutorial.controlsHint: Tap right or Space to strike, tap left or Down to dodge.

objective.description: Flap through the gaps between the pipes to the finish.

tutorial.goalLine: Fly through the pipe gaps to the finish.
tutorial.controlsHint: Tap or Space to flap.

objective.description: Jump across the platforms to the flag without touching the spikes.

tutorial.goalLine: Reach the flag. Jump over gaps and spikes.
tutorial.controlsHint: Arrows or A/D to move, Space or tap to jump.

objective.description: Tap each tile as it reaches the line and play the song to the last beat.

tutorial.goalLine: Tap as each tile hits the line. Three misses end the song.
tutorial.controlsHint: Tap or Space on the beat. M toggles sound.

objective.description: Run to the finish line without hitting an obstacle.

tutorial.goalLine: Reach the finish line. Jump, slide and switch lanes.
tutorial.controlsHint: Tap or Space to jump, swipe or arrows to change lane.

objective.description: Hit every target and stop every wave before it reaches you.

tutorial.goalLine: Hit every target and stop the waves.
tutorial.controlsHint: Tap where you aim to shoot. Arrows aim, Space fires.

theme.setting: twisty race track lined with tire walls

objective.description: Steer through the bends and cross the finish line before the rival cars.

tutorial.goalLine: Beat the rival cars to the finish line.
tutorial.controlsHint: Drag or arrows to steer. Down or a second finger brakes.

objective.description: Hit every target before you run out of throws.

tutorial.goalLine: Hit every target before the throws run out.
tutorial.controlsHint: Hold to power up, drag up or down to aim, let go to throw.

objective.description: Stop each swinging block over the tower. Stack eight to reach the top.

tutorial.goalLine: Stop each block over the tower. Stack 8 to win.
tutorial.controlsHint: Tap or Space to drop the block.
